summary.text: Peter Lovett is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 8 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor, he earned a degree from Yale Divinity School in 1989.

paragraphs.text: Peter Lovett lives in Holderness, New Hampshire, and earned a degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1983 and from Yale Divinity School in 1989.
His career experience includes working as a Christian minister and pastor.
Lovett volunteered with the Peace Corps in Togo, West Africa, from 1983 to 1985.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee.
